UPDATE track_stages
           SET status = 'pending', attempts = 0, redelivered = 0, next_attempt_at = NULL,
               evidence = '{"reason":"enrichment wiped"}'::jsonb,
               started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
           WHERE stage = 'recording' AND status IN ('done', 'working')
             AND track_id = ANY($1)
           RETURNING track_id
